head: iPhone Duo scam: fake online stores offer the foldable iPhone at a discount
dek: Kaspersky found fake websites selling the sold-out iPhone Duo, including one in Apple's style offering 25% off with a 30-minute countdown; buyers lose their money and card details.
details: Some pages let you choose your language and currency. One aimed at Portuguese speakers asked for the WhatsApp number and email to "check availability", exposing people to more scams.
means: If you see a cheap iPhone Duo with a ticking timer, it's very likely a scam.
todo: Buy the iPhone Duo only from Apple, your carrier or a known retailer, and never share card details on a site you reached from an ad or message.
